summary: Metropolitan Bank Holding Corp. filed an 8-K on July 20, 2026, under Item 8.01 to announce a quarterly cash dividend increase from $0.25 to $0.35 per share, payable August 11, 2026, to holders of record July 31, 2026. The board approved the increase as a routine capital return event. No special situation like an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is involved. The filing is a standard dividend declaration with no structural mechanics or regulatory clock. Watch for future dividend policy changes but no risk-arb angle here.
